'''Dantooine Farmstead''' was a type of real estate property on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], available on the [[Stronghold directory terminal|Stronghold market]] during the [[Inter-Sith Wars period]].<ref name="Stronghold" />

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Dantooine Farmstead is a Dantooine stronghold first introduced in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
